subject: Slate Health — post-discovery recap and Q4 approval pulse
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Emily Carter <emily.carter@slatehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Slate Health discovery — recap, MAP, and tentative Q4 timing

Hi Emily — great to connect this morning. Thanks for walking us through Slate Health's priority areas; I wanted to capture the key points and next steps so we have a single record.

Quick recap from our side:
- Primary use case: augment clinician notes for post-visit summarization and coding suggestions (low-latency, PHI-aware).
- Target SLA: 200ms p50 for summary generation; ~5k monthly active users initially.
- Compliance: SOC 2 required; on-prem or VPC Private deployment likely for initial pilot.
- Decision-makers: you (Emily), Head of Clinical Ops (Dana Morales), and Procurement (copied).

Mutual action plan (MAP) — proposed:
1) Redwood to deliver a short pilot SOW + security pack (SOC2 evidence + minimal network diagram) — by Oct 6. [attached: Slate-Discovery-Notes.pdf]
2) Tech workshop with Rishi to validate integration (API + KV cache behavior) — week of Oct 11.
3) Procurement review and contract redlines — you to confirm timeline (you mentioned end-of-quarter cadence).
4) Pilot kickoff target: Nov 1 if procurement and security checks align.

Open questions for you: is the Nov 1 pilot start still realistic given your internal approval windows? Also, can you confirm budget band (you shared earlier a mid-six-figure pilot allocation — any change there)?

Attachments: Slate-Discovery-Notes.pdf, MAP-v1.xlsx, draft SOW placeholder (redwood-pilot-SOW-draft.docx).

If it helps, I can be flexible on the pilot scope to fit a compressed approval (smaller pilot + production option later). Suggest a quick 20-min touchpoint on Oct 8 to align.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
viv ek.kulkarni@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0132

--
Redwood Inference — production-first LLM inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Emily Carter <emily.carter@slatehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Oct 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: quick bump — pilot timing and approvals (Slate Health)

Hi Emily — just nudging this up your inbox. Wanted to check whether you had a chance to review the MAP and draft SOW I sent. If Nov 1 is tight, we can propose a compressed pilot (3-week scope) that focuses on note-summarization only — that would reduce integration surface and speed approvals.

Proposed next steps this week:
- Confirm: who needs the SOC2 evidence vs who needs an on-prem deployment plan?
- Quick call (15 min) to lock pilot scope if you have stakeholders available.

If helpful, Marissa is ready to run a procurement checklist and provide a short redline-friendly contract that Procurement can review.

Thanks — appreciate any guidance on priority/timing changes as you close your quarter.

Vivek
From: Emily Carter <emily.carter@slatehealth.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@slatehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Oct 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: quick bump — pilot timing and approvals (Slate Health)

Vivek — apologies for the slow reply; we've had a shifting window on the budget approvals. Quick update from our side:
- We are briefing Dana (Head of Clinical Ops) this week; she wants a tighter cost estimate before committing to the Nov start.
- Procurement is under a Q4 freeze for new vendors until the 15th of next month unless the pilot is strictly scoped under $40k.
- SOC2 evidence is mandatory; on-prem is preferred but we can accept a VPC deployment if contractual controls are explicit.

Can you provide a pared-down pilot SOW with a fixed not-to-exceed cost and a short SOC2 summary we can share with Procurement? If we can get that by Oct 23 I can push for an exception; otherwise we'll need to move to the next budget window (early Q1).

Thanks — Emily
Emily Carter
Director, Strategic Partnerships
Slate Health
emily.carter@slatehealth.com | 617-555-0199

Subject: Re: quick bump — pilot timing and approvals (Slate Health)

Thanks for the update, Emily — really helpful. We can absolutely do a pared-down pilot with a fixed NTE and a concise SOC2 package. Next steps from our side (I can get these to you by Oct 23):
- Finalize a 3-week pilot SOW scoped to note-summarization only, capped at $38,500 NTE. [I will attach the SOW and an executive SOC2 summary].
- Rishi will prepare a short tech note on VPC vs on-prem network requirements and an integration checklist for Procurement.
- Marissa will be available to take Procurement redlines and accelerate contract review once we have the SOW.

If Procurement needs a procurement-specific contact for legal terms, loop Marissa and I will set up a 30-min review slot. Would it help if we also offered a pilot payment schedule (50% upfront, 50% on delivery) to smooth approvals?

Open ask: if you can confirm by Oct 23 whether Procurement will accept the NTE model, we'll be able to reserve capacity and hold the Nov window as a target. If not, we can pivot to early-Q1 and I'll flag that in our internal capacity planning.

I'll attach the SOW + SOC2 summary in my follow-up email later today.

Best,
Vivek
